name: buddy
description: Claude Code buddy plugin: Quack the ASCII duck waddles above your prompt and talks back — or bring back your /buddy

character.title: Character id (see /buddy-personality)
character.description: The character drawn above the prompt; a pick in /buddy-personality overrides it for this machine, and picking this one there returns to it.

characterDir.title: Folder of your own character JSON files
characterDir.description: Each {id}.json in it is a character (see the plugin's schema/character.schema.json); an id shared with a built-in replaces the built-in. Empty: built-ins only.

motion.title: Walk along the prompt line
motion.description: Off: the character stands still and only animates in place.

questionMode.title: /buddy questions: complete (fast, sees the last contextTurns turns), fork (sees the whole chat), or off
questionMode.description: complete: a fast call on quipModel at the effort option's level, seeing the chat's last contextTurns turns (your prompts and Claude's answers), answered at once even while the main turn runs. fork: answers only from a fork of this chat (its model and context, served from its prompt cache), never quipModel; asked while the main turn runs, it waits for that turn to end; before the chat's first reply it says there is nothing to fork yet; in a long chat an answer can take a minute. off: no model call.

quips.title: The buddy says a line at the end of every answered turn (spends tokens)
quips.description: One short call at the end of every answered turn (see turnMode) writes the buddy's in-character line and, with suggestions on, the prompt suggestion too. Set false to keep the buddy quiet.

quipModel.title: Model for the buddy's lines, suggestions and questions
quipModel.description: An alias (opus, sonnet, haiku), a full model id, or inherit: the main chat's model, read at every call (opus when it cannot be read). It writes the end-of-turn line and suggestion and answers questions that do not fork.

effort.title: How hard quipModel thinks: low, medium, high, xhigh, max or inherit
effort.description: The effort of every quipModel call the buddy makes (the end-of-turn line and suggestion, questions that do not fork); a fork keeps the chat's own. Higher is slower. inherit uses the main chat's level, read at every call, when Claude Code exposes it (CLAUDE_EFFORT), and otherwise sends none, so the model's default applies.

quipCooldownSec.title: Minimum seconds between the buddy's lines
quipCooldownSec.description: A line waits at least this long after the previous one; 0 is every answered turn. The suggestion is written every turn regardless.

suggestions.title: The buddy writes the prompt suggestion (spends tokens)
suggestions.description: The same short call at the end of every answered turn (see turnMode) proposes your next prompt, in your words. Claude Code's own suggestion is held back and shown only when the buddy has none. Set false to keep Claude Code's own.

memory.title: How many recent exchanges the buddy remembers (0 = off)
memory.description: Counts exchanges, not lines or tokens: an exchange is a /buddy question with its answer (or the question alone if it got none), or one line the buddy said. They go into its next answer or quip, kept per session and per character; at most 30.

turnMode.title: End-of-turn line and suggestion: complete (fast, last contextTurns turns) or fork (the whole chat)
turnMode.description: complete: one short call on quipModel at the effort option's level, seeing the chat's last contextTurns turns and the buddy's own small prompt; about 3 seconds. fork: a fork of this chat on the main chat's own model, effort and prompt cache, seeing the whole chat; in a long chat it can take about a minute, and a suggestion that arrives after your next prompt is dropped.

contextTurns.title: How many recent turns the buddy reads (1 to 10)
contextTurns.description: How many of the chat's latest answered turns (your prompt and Claude's answer each) a call that does not fork reads: complete questions and the complete end-of-turn call. More turns, more tokens per call.

logLevel.title: Log level: error, info or debug
logLevel.description: What the plugin writes to logFile: error only failures; info also sessions, commands, asks and their outcomes, quips, menu picks; debug also question text, model result shapes and band decisions. Never your identity.

logFile.title: Log file (empty = no log file)
logFile.description: The default follows CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR: $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/buddy/buddy.log when it is set, ~/.claude/buddy/buddy.log when it is not. A path you give is used as written, with ~ as your home folder and a leading $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR as the config folder. One JSON line per record, retried when another session writes at the same moment, capped at 1 MB with one rotation (.1). /buddy log shows its path and last 20 lines. Empty: no log file; failures still go to the debug log.

ambiguousWidth.title: Ambiguous-width characters: narrow or wide
ambiguousWidth.description: How many columns your terminal gives East Asian ambiguous-width characters (a CJK locale often draws them wide): narrow 1, wide 2. The bubble and the sprite are laid out to it.
